messages:
matt (devex): Heads-up — our SDK cutover is in slot B (02:00 UTC) but infra just asked to swap us into slot A (00:30) because of a customer demo. Can we do that without breaking the disttag/pinning flow?

anya: Possible. Main concerns: signer rotation window and the npm dist-tag overlap. slot A is tight — we normally need 45m for wheels + smoke. :timer_clock:

matt (devex): understood. My checklist: build wheels, sign, publish to staging, smoke-publish to npm with dist-tag 'canary-guest', run end-to-end tests, then flip dist-tag -> 'latest', post release notes. If any step fails we rollback by re-tagging previous sha.

deploy-bot: matt (devex) requested slot change to 00:30 UTC for channel devex. Automated checks: artifacts signed: false, current pipeline: queued. To proceed, confirm manual override with `/deploy confirm-slot-swap 1781819000 slotA`.

rachael: quick Q — do we have a signed fallback wheel already uploaded to s3? If not, rollback means retagging npm only; pip installs could still pull broken package.

anya: we have the last GA wheel artifact at s3://redwood-artifacts/sdk/python/2024.11.1/wheel.whl — not signed with the new key. For safe rollback we should keep the old dist-tag and restore it on failure, then follow up with a signed republish.

ben: If we move to slot A I want an explicit rollback criteria list in the thread. My suggestion:
- any publish step that errors (401/403/5xx) -> abort and do not flip dist-tag
- failing smoke tests (>=2 critical tests) -> re-tag previous 'latest' and notify SRE
- signing key mismatch -> pause and escalate to security (no dist-tag flip)

matt (devex): agree. I'll run an orchestrated smoke script: `scripts/release/smoke.sh --npm --pip --e2e` and gate the dist-tag flip on exit code 0.

deploy-bot: reminder: when publishing to npm use `npm publish --tag staging-canary` then `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<new> latest` as a second step. Bot will annotate releases in #release-notes with the artifact links.

rachael: also add a short deprecation blurb to the release notes for the legacy sync client (we're sunsetting 0.x next month). Draft snippet: "Deprecation: sync-client 0.x will be unsupported after 2025-05-01; please migrate to @redwood/sdk v1.x async client. Migration guide: <link>"

anya: allocation note: slot A change means we need a one-hour post-cutover watch. Can someone own oncall? I'll take the first 30m if Ben can pick up the next 30.

ben: I'll take it. I'll also be ready to run `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<previous> latest` if needed.

matt (devex): ok proceeding with slot swap. Action items:
- matt: run release pipeline at 00:00 UTC (kickoff)
- anya: verify signer and s3 fallback present (pre-checks done by 00:10)
- deploy-bot: allow manual slot override (awaiting `/deploy confirm-slot-swap`)
- ben, rachael: oncall watch and rollback ready

matt (devex): /deploy confirm-slot-swap 1781819000 slotA — doing a quick dry run of smoke locally, will post logs here. :ship:
